title: Riglane Struct Schema (Meta-Schema)
description: Meta-schema describing valid struct schema files (used by workflow.yaml outputs[].struct references). Two styles are supported: 'Standard JSON Schema style' (recommended; type:object + required + properties) and 'Custom format style' (legacy; explicit format: json|markdown|yaml + json_schema/frontmatter/required_sections). All struct files SHOULD declare name and description at top level.
$comment: additionalProperties is FALSE at top level on purpose: an unrecognized key here is silent, total loss of validation, not a harmless extra. The reader keys field definitions off `properties` exactly, so a near-miss like `fields:` leaves properties = {} — the required-presence loop still runs (the schema LOOKS alive) while every type/enum/pattern/min_items constraint is never read. Three shipped tools-demo schemas sat like that for three months. Nested blocks stay open where the reader tolerates extras.

name.description: Convention: struct identifier (matches the basename of <name>.schema.yaml and the value referenced from workflow.yaml outputs[].struct). Not enforced by the validator but expected by tooling.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this struct represents.

version.description: Optional author-facing schema version. Not interpreted by the validator; carried for human bookkeeping.

type.description: Standard-style discriminator: when type=object + required/properties is present, format is auto-detected as json.

json_schema.description: Custom-style: validation rules for JSON files. Used when format: json is set explicitly.

optional_fields.description: Informational: documents fields that MAY be present without being required. Not enforced by the current validator (schema_validate.py ignores this block); kept for documentation purposes.

yaml_schema.description: Custom-style: validation rules for YAML files. Used when format: yaml is set explicitly.

optional_fields.description: Informational: documents fields that MAY be present. Not enforced by current validator.

frontmatter.description: Markdown-style: validation rules for YAML frontmatter. Used when format: markdown is set.

required_sections.description: Markdown-style: required '## Heading' section names (without the leading '##').

anyOf.$comment: Standard JSON Schema style: declares type:object + required and/or properties.
Custom format style: declares explicit format with matching companion block.
File-checks-only struct (existence + size, no content schema).

fileChecks.description: File-level checks applied regardless of format.

exists.description: Require the file to exist. Default: true.

name_pattern.description: Regex matched against file basename only.

standardField.description: Field schema in JSON Schema style. Recursive: nested objects/arrays use the same definition.

customField.description: Field declaration in custom format style. Supports dot notation (metadata.name) and array notation (tasks[].domain, tasks[].items[].id for nested).

field.description: Field path. Use dots for nested objects, '[]' as an array marker. Examples: 'metadata.name', 'tasks[].domain', 'domains[].requirements[].title'.

values.description: Alias for enum (used in some legacy specs).

frontmatterField.description: Frontmatter field declaration. Supports the cross-field 'body_match_section' check that requires the field's value to appear literally in a named ## section of the markdown body (RFC2119-style validator pattern).

body_match_section.description: When set, the field's value MUST appear literally (case-insensitive) in the body of the named ## section. Cross-field consistency check.
